name: Cool-down Lap
author: vmknolle
description: After the chequered flag the player keeps driving a cool-down lap to parc ferme; the AI top 3 park there too, with 1/2/3 boards.

options.label: Cool-down lap
options.description: After the chequered flag you keep driving until you park in parc ferme (or the time runs out); the podium follows.

options.label: Cool-down lap: at most (s)
options.description: The cool-down ends on its own after this time. On long tracks the limit grows to a cool-down lap at about 100 km/h plus 90 s.

options.label: Cool-down lap: ends when
options.description: Parked in parc ferme, pit lane entry, or time only.

options.label: Cool-down lap: AI top 3 park in parc ferme
options.description: The first three AI cars park in front of the podium too.

options.label: Parc ferme marking in the cool-down (prototype)
options.description: Puts the podium's parc ferme floor with the P1/P2/P3 boxes at the track's parc ferme as soon as the cool-down starts, when the game has it loaded. Every try is written to loader.log.

options.label: Log details
options.description: Pit states, controller handovers and phase changes in the loader log.
